landing.heroSubtitle: Traditional banking makes impulse spending way too easy. Tijori locks your savings away in KWD and gives the emergency approval key to your most trusted person.
landing.worksWithCard: Works with your existing KWD bank card.
landing.previewSub: See how Tijori keeps your savings locked and accountable in real-time.
landing.howItWorksSub: Three simple steps between your impulse and your goal.
landing.step1Desc: Name your goal, set your target amount, and choose when you want to achieve it.
landing.step2Title: We save a little, on schedule
landing.step2Desc: Auto-pulls small amounts from your card on your allowance or salary day before you spend it.
landing.step3Title: Your trusted person holds the key
landing.step3Desc: Need to break it early? Write an honest excuse. Your trusted person decides whether to open it or protect your goal.
landing.approvalHeading: Your trusted person gets the excuse. Not the money.
landing.approvalStory1: When impulse strikes, you can't just swipe and withdraw.
landing.approvalStory2: You write what you want to buy, and Ahmed gets the notification.
landing.approvalStory3: If he says no, your savings stay locked and your streak survives.
landing.mockupUser: Abdulrahman wants to unlock London Summer Trip
landing.mockupExcuse: Found a limited sneaker drop at 360 Mall.
landing.mockupAiNote: Third break request this month. 18-day streak at stake.
landing.mockupUnlocked: Unlocked. 15% solo fee or 5% friend approval.
landing.rulesHeading: Two ways out. One protects your future.
landing.rulesSub: Your savings stay locked until your target date. If impulse strikes and you truly need to break early, you choose your path:
landing.ruleFriendDesc: Send an honest excuse to your trusted keyholder. If they approve, your safe opens with only a minor {fee}% fee (you keep {keep}%). If they say NO, 0% is lost and your savings streak survives.
landing.ruleFriendBullet1: Friend approves: you keep {keep}% of your savings
landing.ruleFriendBullet2: Friend denies: 0 KWD deducted, streak stays unbroken
landing.ruleSelfDesc: No friend around or need to unlock immediately? You can break the vault yourself anytime—a {fee}% emergency fee is kept as a fee.
landing.ruleSelfBullet1: Instant emergency unlock without asking anyone
landing.ruleSelfBullet2: {fee}% emergency fee kept as a fee to protect your future
landing.ruleSelfBullet3: Forces you to think four times before breaking
landing.rulesComparisonFriend: friend says yes, you keep 95 KWD (5 KWD fee)
landing.rulesComparisonSelf: emergency self-break, you keep 85 KWD (15 KWD fee)
landing.roasterHeading: Test an excuse before you break
landing.roasterSub: See how Tijori calls you out in seconds before you pay emergency fees or face your friend.
landing.roasterPlaceholder: Type your excuse (e.g. Flash sneaker drop at 360 Mall)...
landing.whySub: Made for how you actually spend.
landing.why1Desc: No sneaky instant withdrawals. Your future self comes first.
landing.why2Desc: Your friend is harder to convince than you are.
landing.why3Desc: Save 5, 25, or 100 KWD weekly or monthly without changing your lifestyle.
landing.why4Desc: Timed for university student allowances and end-of-month paychecks.
